Available in Europe and Israel, this initiative supports startups that are building cutting-edge AI solutions for European regulatory environments. Artificial intelligence represents an estimated €1.2 trillion economic opportunity for Europe . AI.title: Sovereign AI in Europe: New ways to control your AI stack
AI.summary: Today in Brussels, public sector leaders, policymakers and partners are meeting at the Sovereign AI Summit to discuss how to build the next decade of Europe's public services, healthcare, and finance with AI under European control. We're here with our European partners to help deliver it. Achieving that goal takes more than deciding where data is stored. Technology.title: Gamers in Asia stoked to play 'GTA VI', many on grey market
Technology.summary: It’s censored in Japan, not officially sold in China, and has floundered in Asian markets where mobile games are king, but “ Grand Theft Auto ” fever is sweeping the continent regardless. Technology.title: US releases details of Megaspeed probe, says investigation began in 2024
Technology.summary: The US Commerce Department and Justice Department released information on Monday about Washington’s investigation into Singapore-based cloud-computing company Megaspeed, Nvidia’s Asia-Pacific partner, which the departments said began two years ago. Megaspeed has come under scrutiny after reports that Nvidia’s former CEO Jensen Huang had an affair with Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, a former top executive at Megaspeed who some US authorities suspect had ties to Chinese espionage efforts. stories.title: Amazon EMR 8.2 is now available
stories.summary: Amazon EMR 8.2 is now available with new features across Amazon EMR on EC2, Amazon EMR on EKS, and Amazon EMR Serverless. This release upgrades Apache Spark to 4.1.3, Apache Iceberg to 1.11.0, and Delta Lake to 4.2.0, and it is designated a Long Term Support (LTS) release. stories.title: How to Build Durable Agentic Systems with Google Antigravity: From Instructions to Loops
stories.summary: I watched the discussion on agentic loops grow louder over the past few months. But for me, the reality is simpler: prompt engineering has shifted from individual tasks to systems design, and the harness around the model (not the model itself) is now my primary constraint in software engineering. In this article, I'll show you how to build and verify those harnesses so you can move from single-turn instructions to durable agentic loops in Google Antigravity . stories.title: Introducing the Apache Spark Optimization Agent for Amazon EMR Serverless
stories.summary: Amazon EMR Serverless now offers the Apache Spark optimization agent, which analyzes completed Spark job runs and delivers cost and performance optimization recommendations in seconds. You can select a cost or performance goal, and the agent returns specific configuration changes with the telemetry evidence and plain-language reasoning behind each suggestion. The agent can analyze a single run or compare it against a known-good baseline to pinpoint what changed. You access it from the EMR Server

stories.title: Chrome for Android Update
stories.summary: Hi, everyone! We've just released Chrome 158 (158.0.8127.42) for Android. It'll become available on Google Play over the next few days. This release includes stability and performance improvements. You can see a full list of the changes in the Git log . If you find a new issue, please let us know by filing a bug . Android releases contain the same security fixes as their corresponding Desktop releases (Windows & Mac: 158.0.8127.36 /.37 Linux: 158.0.8127.36 ) unless otherwise noted. Krishna Govin
